items.expected_conclusion: The three cationic Ir(III) complexes have source-reported S0–T1 gaps above 0.98 eV, supporting energetic plausibility of type-II singlet-oxygen sensitization within the stated computational boundary; the result does not alone establish biological efficacy or a complete mechanism.
